title: Putin and Modi expand India-Russia economic ties in talks in New Delhi
summary: India gave Russia's leader a warm welcome in his first visit since his country invaded Ukraine. The visit in part signaled India's defiance of the U.S., which has punished New Delhi for buying Russian oil.
